question: When can a bounded reasoner justify acting, falling back, or buying a specified computation when the computation-outcome model and assessment of its own versioned procedure are uncertain and costly?
reliable_gain: Derive and independently verify finite paid-computation decision and stopping rules, with matched ordinary metareasoning, explicit budgets, versioned acquired profiles, and full cost decomposition.
exploratory_gain: Determine which robust improvement guarantees survive uncertain outcome profiles, shared dependence, complementary computations, objective changes, and assessment overhead; implement a decision-relevant bounded mathematical-query case.
likely_failure: Profile uncertainty or assessment overhead makes certified purchases vacuous; pointwise or myopic value calculations ignore selection, coupled laws, or complementary computations; an ordinary exact method already dominates.
first_informative_check: Compare finite policy-level improvement certificates with branchwise/myopic decisions on exact counterexamples, then inspect whether an acquired version-bound performance profile can support a nonvacuous paid choice without a free oracle.
criteria: Specify finite information, action/fallback/computation catalogue and hard resource budget.
Derive at least one bounded value-of-computation guarantee with explicit uncertain-benefit assumptions, or a precise failure witness.
Obtain or bound performance information through charged permitted evidence; no free true outcome law in the implemented policy.
Charge forecasting, assessment, evaluation/proof, acquisition, storage, checking and relevant dependency/repair construction/search.
Compare equal accuracy under unequal stakes and objective changes; separate better estimates from changed or improved decisions.
Assess the reasoner own explicitly versioned procedure within a bounded scope.
Compare matched ordinary metareasoning and charged exact computation; identify inherited mechanisms and any demonstrated integration contribution.
Independent proof reconstruction and meaningful implementation checks; all experiments development.
Research90 verified only from observed nonoverlapping principal D/L/E intervals.
concurrency_policy: Independent agent evidence is reviewed by the principal; no parallel agent minutes added to principal clocks.
closure_policy: Complete P3-07 only; do not run P3-B or P3-08 automatically. No final evaluation freeze or P3-N01 support inferred from the floor.
